question: Can a trained two-pass decoder correct its own genuine failed calculator calls, improve fresh human word-problem answers against untouched Base and preserve all unaffected behavior of the qualified installation?
protocol: Collect exactly one free opening per 256 publisher GSM8K training problems with verified executable solutions using the unmodified qualified typed two-pass adapter. The native fixed calculator must actually reject at least 64 calls. Archive every attempt, including successes and invalid JSON. Only actual callback exceptions supply fitting examples. For each eligible opening, train a different adapter on the complete failed exchange followed by the publisher's executed correct program, then on the same history plus the correct actual observation followed by the answer. The causal first turn on every scored problem is frozen. The candidate loads the learned view only after the real built-in calculator raises an exception, dropping that turn's prefix cache on parameter change. Successful calls and unrelated APIs continue on the installed parent. Both arms receive the identical calculator, prompts, 384-token greedy thinking, terminal and three-turn limits. Run 24 previously unenrolled ASDiv and 24 SVAMP questions, along with all 50 previous deployment requests and all 22 public functions, cold, shuffled once, and save every actual prompt, call and physical history. Nothing repairs an invalid candidate outside the three turns. This is a learned system comparison, not a depth ablation.
gate: Close immediately without training or evaluation if fewer than 64 genuine opening errors. On the 48 fresh questions require eight net grounded gains and four net final-answer gains against untouched ordinary Base, both exact two-sided paired p<=.05, and six correct completions after a real callback exception. Require at least Base's final-answer score separately for each human source. Across all 120 require a positive paired strict gain p<=.05, no earlier 50-field or 22-public correct item lost, all earlier opening and unaffected transcripts exactly reproducible, and no greater summed first delay, end-to-end time or peak native allocation. A failed gate closes promotion and dependent jobs. Only a pass licenses a new independent panel and matched equal-exposure K1 experiment. Stop at the registered native cap.
